transport_options.description: Crossing from mainland Bali to Nusa Penida island
Speedboat transfer from Sanur Harbour to Nusa Penida across the Bali Strait. Journey takes approximately 35–45 minutes. Speedboats generally operate from 7:30 AM onwards.
